passages.text: Demo Unit Hot 8 (fixture): The door gasket is mounted in a channel around the door frame. To replace the gasket, open the door fully, pull the old gasket out of the channel starting at a corner, and press the new gasket in evenly. No tools are required. Fixture text - not from a ScanBox manual.
Demo Unit Hot 8 (fixture): The cabinet holds food at an adjustable temperature of up to +90 C. Allow 20 minutes of preheating before loading. Fixture text - not from a ScanBox manual.
Demo Unit Cold 12 (fixture): Clean the condenser grille every month. Disconnect the mains plug before cleaning. Fixture text - not from a ScanBox manual.
